name: Najibabad

queries.query: Najibabad Uttar Pradesh official cadastral parcel map GIS Bijnor land records
queries.result: Found the first-party Uttar Pradesh Bhulekh portal, the official Bijnor district portal, the official UP Bhu-Naksha portal, and the UP cadastral digitization report specifically listing Bijnor/Najibabad. The report evidences linked/georeferenced village and mapsheet coverage, but not a city-boundary parcel feature response.

queries.query: नजीबाबाद उत्तर प्रदेश आधिकारिक भू-नक्शा खसरा नक्शा बिजनौर
queries.result: Found the official Hindi UP Bhulekh/Bhu-Naksha services and the Najibabad tehsil cadastral digitization report. Hindi search results also confirmed the official service labels for भू-नक्शा/शजरा and गाटा, but no anonymous parcel geometry was returned.

officialSources.operator: Board of Revenue, Government of Uttar Pradesh / NIC Uttar Pradesh
officialSources.evidence: First-party state land-record portal describes UP land records and links to भू-नक्शा, गाटा and related land services. This is state registry/custodian evidence, not merely general national agency prose.

officialSources.operator: Government of Uttar Pradesh cadastral digitization dashboard
officialSources.evidence: The official report identifies district Bijnor, tehsil Najibabad, and lists revenue villages with cadastral digitization flags. Search/indexed report totals show 520 of 520 villages linked to Bhunaksha and 584 of 584 mapsheets linked and georeferenced for Najibabad tehsil.

Current public viewer is the first-party UP cadastral map route. Its current JavaScript configuration exposes https://upbhunaksha.gov.in/bhunakshaserver and plot/map methods including MapInfo/getPlotAtXY, MapInfo/getPlotByPlotNo, MapInfo/getPlotInfo, and v1/khasramap/plot.

officialSources.operator: Government of Uttar Pradesh / Bijnor land-records administration
officialSources.evidence: Official document records inauguration of the web-based land-record system at Tehsil Najibabad, Bijnor. It supports local administrative custody but does not expose parcel geometry.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Retrieved current HTML and JavaScript asset references. The state portal was reachable and its CSP/configuration exposed the public Bhunaksha and related endpoints.
Retrieved the current public Bhu-Naksha viewer shell and JavaScript configuration. No credentials, login, CAPTCHA bypass, or private token was used.
The current viewer-discovered public metadata route did not return within the bound. This is an endpoint/transport limitation, not evidence of absent Najibabad coverage.
The bounded route sequence was stopped after the first endpoint timed out; no map query was fabricated and no point-hit/absence inference was made.
Official report was discoverable and returned Najibabad tehsil village/map digitization records. It is aggregate/report evidence, not a parcel feature API response.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: First-party local administrative custody and aggregate Najibabad tehsil digitization status verified. City-specific parcel geometry, exact city boundary coverage, and anonymous feature schema were not verified.
coverageAssessment.targetPointHitInterpretation: No usable exact-point parcel response was obtained. This is an endpoint/availability limitation, not evidence of citywide absence.
